::: {#exm-simple-graph}
#### Simple or not

- The office graph of @exm-office-graph is simple (@def-simple-graph):
  each of its edges has two endpoints, and no two of its edges have the same endpoints.
- The graph of @exm-loop-parallel is not simple, since it has a loop and two parallel edges.
- The bridge graph of @exm-konigsberg is not simple, since it has parallel edges.

In a simple graph, each edge is the only edge with its two endpoints,
so writing each edge as the set of its endpoints, as in @exm-office-graph, names every edge exactly once.

:::
